answer: Random transcript audit works because the re-derivation cost sits on a horizon the operator cannot see coming: each epoch the chain samples one stored answer per identity, issues a fresh nonce at sampling instant, and demands the author reproduce the full reasoning chain under that nonce so no pre-baked transcript survives. The verifier replays the fresh trace against the stored delta derivation; a single mismatch near the canyon between claimed and actual compute flags the identity, and a second mismatch at the audit nadir freezes emission and forces manual review.
